source_rendering_authority.scope: complete static source-module closure of public solve7x6 and Lazy SMP worker entry

declared_target: exact Lazy SMP solve result under the 0.2 exact gate
clean invocation termination under the current host contract

support_findings.subject: WAKE increment/notify path
support_findings.current_host_consumer: none; host polls STOP/DONE on interval
support_findings.scope: current Lazy SMP host observation of exact result / termination
support_findings.nonconsequence: not globally removable from generic ManagedThreadSession or other compositions without consumer audit

support_findings.subject: shared exact cache
support_findings.observed_workload_result: 100% measured shared stores and hits were CPC_EXACT in the provenance census
support_findings.nonconsequence: does not establish that every future shared result is CPC_EXACT or that shared caching is globally optimal

support_findings.subject: metrics/result publication before WINNER CAS
support_findings.effect: winner means first worker to win CAS after publication, not necessarily first solver computation to finish
support_findings.reason: metrics and result rows may be externally required outputs; target contract must state whether they may change

valuation_rule: no implementation preference is selected without represented/derived/measured valuation evidence
dp08_boundaries: locally unused WAKE does not imply global irrelevance
exact-result sufficiency does not permit dropping required metrics/provenance outputs
measured CPC_EXACT-only sharing is workload-scoped evidence
no value system is inferred from graph size or transition count
